description: This file contains JavaScript code for UI interactions, including navigation setup, battery indicator, educational tips, firewall display, delete confirmation dialogs, form validation, and utility functions, specific to the 'gateway' namespace.

methods.name: setupLeftNavigation
methods.description: Initializes the left navigation menu, handling selection, folder toggling, and browser-specific fixes.

methods.name: setupBatteryIndicator
methods.description: Updates battery icon based on battery percentage.

methods.name: setupEducationalTip
methods.description: Sets up toggle for educational tips display.

methods.name: setupFirewallDisplay
methods.description: Handles toggle of firewall security level details.

methods.name: setupDeleteConfirmDialogs
methods.description: Attaches confirmation dialogs to delete links.

methods.name: setupFormValidation
methods.description: Configures form validation rules and messages, including custom validation methods for IP addresses, MAC addresses, and password strength.

methods.name: setupTooltipInHeader
methods.description: Initializes tooltip display on header status items.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Main initialization function that sets page title, navigation, dialogs, validation, and fixes.

methods.name: breakWord
methods.description: Inserts spaces into long strings at specified intervals to prevent overflow.

methods.name: radioToButton
methods.description: Converts radio button groups into button-like toggles with optional auto-submit.
